qc_rules.description: The camera's video stream did not open (Caltrans takes feeds down for maintenance or incidents)
The stream opened but no frames could be decoded
The stream stalled and delivered under the minimum share of expected frames
The stream is up but shows a black frame or Caltrans' flat 'No video' card (very low brightness or contrast)
Consecutive frames are effectively identical so the picture is not live
The sun is below the horizon; headlight glare makes vehicle detection unreliable (measured in rpt_detection_accuracy)
Sharpness is far below the camera's own normal (fog, rain on the lens, smearing)
